growth_signal.value: Its platform has powered more than 10 billion AI generations, with customers including Wix, Together.ai, Quora and Higgsfield.

raised.note: confirmed by two sources in the run; the URLs were not saved

entry.idea: Runware provides one fast, low-cost API that lets other companies generate AI images, audio and video for their own products, in under a second.
entry.lesson: When many companies need to run the same expensive AI task, sell the fast, cheap infrastructure instead of competing on the end product.
entry.name: Runware

growth.reason: Powering more than 10 billion AI generations with named enterprise customers is a large, concrete usage number.

market.reason: Almost any product that adds AI-generated images, audio or video is a potential customer, across many industries worldwide.

tech.reason: Making AI media generation sub-second and cheap at scale is real infrastructure work, though other well-funded AI infra players compete here too.

sources.title: Runware nets $50M Series A for 'one API for all AI' platform - Tech.eu
Runware Announces $50M Series A to Scale AI Inference Infrastructure for Media Workflows

entry.twist: It focuses purely on making AI media generation as fast and cheap as possible to run, rather than building its own AI models or consumer app.
entry.who_pays: Software companies and platforms pay to run AI image, audio and video generation through Runware's API.
entry.why_now: More products now need to generate images, audio and video on demand, and companies want a single, affordable way to plug that in instead of running it themselves.
